description: This file contains the implementation of the DynamoDB-based membership table for Orleans clustering, including methods for initialization, reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up silo membership entries, along with detailed logging.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing silo membership data using Amazon DynamoDB, including methods for initialization, CRUD operations, and cleanup.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB membership table, creating the table if necessary, and optionally inserting a version row.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a version entry in the DynamoDB table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionRecord
methods.description: Constructs a new table version record with specified version and ETag.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries associated with a specific cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo membership entries, ensuring version consistency.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a specified table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry with a new ETag and table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific silo entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are considered defunct based on their last alive timestamp.
